title: Founding Engineer - Robotics Swiss Army Knife
description:
Building the autonomous manufacturing revolution in Munich

Anton Robotics is an early-stage robotics startup founded out of TUM MIRMI and backed by over €1 million in pre-seed funding from a leading European VC. What you will do

  • Develop and integrate hardware and software solutions across diverse robotic platforms.

  • Deploy production-ready automation systems for real industrial environments.

  • Collaborate closely on core architecture to scale manufacturing applications.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in robotics engineering, systems integration, or a closely related technical field.

  • Practical background working with both hardware and software components in production settings.

  • Strong foundation in building scalable robotic solutions.

Your first months at Anton Robotics

In your first months, you will take ownership of core robotics integration tasks, shipping scalable systems for industrial deployments on-site in Munich. Someone who matches most of these requirements should still apply.

Enjoy a sport membership to stay active. Benefit from company stock options and a relocation package if you are moving to Munich. Take advantage of paid sick leave, flexible working hours, and home office options when needed. Participate in regular mentoring sessions and enjoy free lunch, snacks, and beverages at the office. The package also includes a company car, a company laptop, a casual dress code, and 28 vacation days per year.

title: Investment Director (Diagnostics) - Lyon, France
description:
Location : Lyon, France

ABOUT ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services.

ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

THE TEAM

  • An global team with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines.
  • Alumni of INSEAD, Wharton, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others.
  • Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group, KKR), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Stryker, Phillips, Pfizer, Baxter, LivaNova, J&J, Galderma, Sanofi).

THE DIAGNOSTICS TEAM

The Director will serve as a senior investment professional with direct responsibility for sourcing, evaluating and executing investments across the Diagnostics portfolio. The Director will lead deal activity across an assigned geography, technology platform or investment theme, and will carry accountability for investment outcomes, value creation and portfolio company support.

This is a senior operating role combining strategic direction setting with hands-on deal execution, positioning the Director as a trusted senior advisor to Partners and portfolio management teams.

  • Investment Sourcing & Strategy
    • Drive sourcing and pipeline development across assigned Diagnostics sectors or geographies, identifying and cultivating relationships with sellers, intermediaries and LP co-investors.
    • Lead the formation and evolution of investment theses within assigned focus areas, including category mapping, competitive positioning and market trend analysis.
    • Serve as primary investment decision maker and deal sponsor, with direct accountability for investment committee presentations and recommendation.
    • Lead the negotiation of transaction terms, pricing and deal structure in partnership with Partners and external advisors.
  • Due Diligence & Execution
    • Oversee comprehensive commercial, financial and operational due diligence, working with external advisors to validate assumptions and identify key risks and levers.
    • Lead the development of post-acquisition value creation roadmaps, including 100-day plans and multi-year operating strategies.
    • Manage the investment committee approval process and coordinate all transaction closing mechanics with legal and finance teams.
  • Portfolio Leadership & Value Creation
    • Serve as the primary investment relationship owner for assigned portfolio companies, working directly with management teams on strategy, M&A, capital deployment and operational priorities.
    • Lead add-on acquisition identification, evaluation and execution, including syndication with co-investors.
    • Drive performance monitoring and problem-solving, escalating key decisions to Partners and intervention areas to senior management.
    • Sponsor and mentor portfolio company boards, ensuring robust governance and strategic clarity.
  • Team & Platform Development
    • Mentor and develop Senior Analysts and Associate-level team members, contributing to talent development and succession planning within the Diagnostics function.
    • Contribute to ARCHIMED's Diagnostics thought leadership and external positioning through conference participation, investor communication and industry engagement.
    • Identify and build capabilities across the Diagnostics platform to support scaling and evolution of the investment program.

Requirements

  • 8 to 12 years of investment or operating experience, with a strong track record in private equity investing, transaction execution or operational leadership within diagnostics sector.
  • Demonstrated success originating, evaluating and closing significant investments (€50 million+ enterprise value preferred), with evidence of value creation across the portfolio.
  • Deep expertise in the Diagnostics landscape, including brand strategy, omnichannel distribution, and regulatory dynamics .
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills. Able to command credibility with sophisticated management teams, institutional LPs and external partners.
  • Strong financial acumen and fluency with investment modeling, valuation and deal structuring. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
  • Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
  • Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
  • Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
  • Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
  • Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
  • Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
  • Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

  • DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
  • Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
  • GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
  • Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.

title: Operations Specialist, AI Enablement [Content Moderation]
description:
Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Operations Specialist, AI Enablement to join our CX & Trust team. Trust, care, and high-quality experiences are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by improving how our AI-powered customer experience and moderation systems support our community.

You’ll evaluate AI-powered customer interactions and automated moderation decisions against Bumble’s policies, processes, and quality standards, helping us understand where our systems are performing well and where they can improve. Through quality reviews, accurate case labelling, golden-set maintenance, and thoughtful analysis, you’ll help ensure AI-supported decisions are consistent, precise, and grounded in the nuance required to serve our members responsibly. You’ll work closely with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager and colleagues across CX & Trust, taking ownership of high-quality work and demonstrating our Bumble values of Courage, Curiosity, Respect, and Excellence as we reimagine how AI can strengthen trust and care across the member experience.

This role will be based in London and will work in a hybrid model.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards.

  • Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement.

  • Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance.

  • Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision.

  • Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact.

  • Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience.

  • Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset.

  • Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment.

  • Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards.

  • Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness.

  • Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings.

  • Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve.

  • Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues.

About Us

The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.

  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.

Desirable

  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

title: Deployment Strategist - Crypto Investigations
description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

Your time splits between hands-on platform work, enablement, strategy and stakeholder telemetry. One insourced QA Engineer supports you. You own the technical direction, the standards and the quality outcomes.

title: Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d)
description:
Your Role & How we work

As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. Our stack is Python, SQL, AWS, and Databricks.

You report to our Director of Engineering. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes to designing, building, and shipping. The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics. You work closely with Quantitative Research, AI Engineering, Product & Data, and the investment team, and we treat agentic AI as a default in how we build.

What you will do

  • Build and improve the internal products the investment and research teams use daily: data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and tooling, on top of our lakehouse and orchestration stack.

  • Work directly with the teams you build for: take in their requests, triage and prioritise them, protect the integrity and consistency of the product, and explain features and implementation trade-offs in clear, non-technical language.

  • Design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines, ETLs and integrations that handle complex financial and alternative datasets.

  • Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation.

  • Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling.

  • Use agentic AI across engineering work (coding, review, testing, debugging, documentation) and help the team push these practices forward.


The experience you bring

  • 3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production.

  • Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling.

  • Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them.

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain what you built, why, and what it will and will not do, and you can say no constructively.

  • Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work.

  • Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics.

  • Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production.


2 reasons why you should not apply

  • You prefer fully specified tickets and no contact with users. Here the people you build for sit next to you, ask for things directly, and expect you to weigh in on what should be built and how.

  • You treat AI tooling as an occasional helper. We expect agentic AI to be a default in how you build, review, test, and ship, every day, not now and then.


Your mindset

  • You are a builder who loves to ship: pragmatic on trade-offs, careful on quality. You move fast, but fast does not mean sloppy.

  • You care about correctness, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and you leave codebases and teams better than you found them.

  • You are curious about how investment decisions are made and want to understand the data behind them, not just move it.

  • You see AI-powered development as a competitive advantage, not a novelty, and use agentic AI as a core part of how you work.

  • You communicate clearly on progress, trade-offs, and risk, and you own problems end-to-end.


What we offer

  • Work with petabytes of data and the most cutting-edge tools in and beyond asset management, with Day 1 ownership of challenging, varied work and a steep learning curve.

  • Become part of a unique success story in European asset management, alongside the most knowledgeable experts in the industry on one of the most consequential investment themes of the next decade.

  • A motivated, highly international team (15 nationalities) that gathers in person at our Berlin HQ and supports each other, with flat hierarchies and direct interaction with our management team and investors.

  • Visa sponsorship, relocation support, and a competitive compensation package with a meaningful variable component tied to fund performance.

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

  • Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

  • Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (React Native, Swift or Kotlin), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

  • Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

  • Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.


About the role

Taxfix recently launched its first products and services for self-employed people and
small and medium businesses in Germany. The B2B motions these products
need to scale have to be built from the ground up, with support from central
growth and channel experts: acquisition and onboarding, lead generation and
nurturing, sales, retention and expansion. In this role, your mandate is to
find, test and scale what works.

You own SE and SMB growth marketing end to end for Germany. You start from an
insight you found yourself and pick the few opportunities worth the time and
money. Before launch you set the success, kill and scale criteria and what done
means. Then you run the work yourself, or hand it to the expert best placed to
run it, read the result and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill.

Central specialist teams carry the established work, and you collaborate with
them: paid acquisition, CRM, marketing data and MarTech. You decide which
channels, segments and messages to test, and you build the growth loops nobody
at Taxfix has run yet. You work with the B2B product team, the B2B commercial
lead, Product Marketing and our Creative Studio.

What you'll do

  • Find the opportunities worth running. Turn customer conversations, sales
    calls, funnel data and what you observe in the market into hypotheses and
    experiments for SE and SMB growth. Rank them and run them. Pivot when an
    experiment fails, and scale quickly when it works.

  • Build multi-channel strategies. Build an experimentation engine, and use
    its results to shape the multi-channel strategy for awareness and demand
    capture across Taxfix's new B2B products. Central growth teams and channel
    experts carry parts of the mix.

  • Design how each product reaches its customers. For each growth loop,
    decide the ICP segment to focus on, the channel and the message to test, how
    the user flow and experience fit the loop, and the plan for scaling after the
    first positive signals.

  • Plan it, then run it yourself. Set success, kill and scale criteria before
    launch. Build the prototype, landing page, content, onboarding flow or nurture
    sequence with your own hands where that is fastest, and bring in central
    experts where they do it better.

  • Build B2B motions from zero to one. Acquisition and onboarding flows, lead
    generation and nurturing, the handover to inbound sales, retention and
    expansion loops. Several of these exist nowhere at Taxfix today.

  • Read the results and make the call. Separate signal from noise at B2B
    volumes, where samples start small. Decide to scale, iterate or kill, and turn
    the read into recommendations for Product and commercial leadership.

  • Use AI as an operating and growth advantage. Use AI to 10x your
    effectiveness and your outcomes. Build your own prototypes, applets and tools
    for the opportunities you run, and apply AI to discovery, analysis, content,
    experimentation and repeating workflows.

  • Steer budget where the evidence is thin. You hold the mandate to plan and
    allocate budget for new B2B motions and growth loops.

  • Strategist and operator in one person. You pick the opportunities and you

    first version this week over polishing a plan for a month.

    go-to-market, growth, strategy or another go-to-market function, including
    ownership of a product or business outcome.

  • Zero-to-one experience. You took a new product, category, platform or
    business line from the first growth-loop tests, through scaling, to a
    multi-channel playbook.

  • Close to the customer. You naturally stay close to our customers, talk to them, listen to sales calls and use customer insights to inform your decisions.

  • Data literacy. You can define and interpret acquisition, activation, adoption,
    retention, pipeline, conversion, revenue and product-usage metrics, and you
    turn what you find into a decision.

  • Agility and speed. You try new ideas all the time. When one fails, you
    pivot. When one works, you move to scale it. Shifting priorities and tight
    deadlines don't throw you off.

  • Curious about B2B growth and AI. You follow the people and sources moving
    both fields, and you can name what you took from them into your own work.

  • Knowledge of the German market, ideally of how self-employed people and
    small businesses buy. Fluent German is a big plus, not a must.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

title: Site Development Program Manager
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You'll hold Proxima Fusion's site development portfolio together as one program, spanning projects such as Stellaris, our manufacturing and testing infrastructure, and other site development work. Working closely with the project managers who lead each project, you'll make sure feasibility, key partner relationships and permitting strategy are handled coherently across the portfolio. Without this role, projects risk optimizing for themselves while the issues that cut across them fall through the gaps.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead Proxima Fusion's site development program across multiple parallel projects, owning feasibility, key partner and stakeholder relationships, and permitting strategy

  • Work closely with the project managers leading each site, aligning their schedules, budgets and deliverables to a single program roadmap

  • Define and run the program's decision-gate structure, from initial project approval through to final investment decision, including deliverables, readiness levels, and cost and schedule tracking

  • Represent Proxima Fusion to site owners, utility partners and other key stakeholders, building constructive, diplomatic partnerships across sites with different contexts and regulatory histories

  • Own the permitting landscape across the portfolio, including radiation protection law, environmental permitting, building permits and other approvals where relevant, and sequence parallel approval processes into one coherent strategy

  • Build organizational and infrastructure scaling plans that look beyond near-term needs, from initial capacity towards multi-GW scale

  • Report program status, risks and key decisions to senior leadership

WHO YOU ARE

  • Extensive experience leading greenfield or brownfield energy or industrial site development programs through to final investment decision, ideally on former or adjacent nuclear sites or other heavily regulated sites

  • A track record of managing multiple projects in parallel at different stages of maturity, using a structured, gate-based approach

  • Skilled at building productive relationships with incumbent site owners and utilities, and comfortable working within formal, process-driven stakeholder cultures

  • Able to pull together detailed technical requirements from engineers and specialists without needing a deep engineering background yourself

  • Fluent in German and English, which the regulatory and stakeholder landscape requires

  • Comfortable building program structure from scratch in a fast-scaling, first-of-a-kind environment

    INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Senior Account Executive - Airline or Airline Catering (Europe, 100% remote)
description:
Join our fully remote, mission-driven team dedicated to pioneering sustainable inflight service management. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.

Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.

About the role

We are on a mission to contribute to a zero-waste future by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, CO₂ emissions in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision and as a Senior Account Executive, you will be at the heart of the team that makes it possible.

You will report directly to one of the founders and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and the broader founding team.

This is not a traditional SaaS sales role focused on high-volume transactions. Our customers are airlines, our sales cycles are complex, and our relationships often span many years.

You will be responsible for building and executing strategic sales plans, identifying and developing new opportunities, and managing enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through to contract signature.

Rather than relying solely on inbound demand, you will proactively identify target airlines, build stakeholder relationships, and develop opportunities through a structured account-based sales approach.

We are looking for someone who has already built pipeline, navigated complex airline buying processes, and personally closed significant enterprise business. You will bring both the experience and confidence to independently lead opportunities while collaborating effectively with founders and subject matter experts throughout the sales process.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. While you will mentor and coach junior sales colleagues, your primary responsibility is generating pipeline, advancing opportunities, and winning new business. If your primary motivation is managing teams rather than selling, this role is not going to be a good fit.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Enterprise Sales

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature

  • Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for airline customers

  • Build relationships with executive and senior stakeholders

  • Lead commercial negotiations and enterprise procurement processes

  • Create and maintain strategic account plans

Pipeline Generation & Market Development

  • Identify and pursue new growth opportunities with airlines globally

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities

  • Develop stakeholder maps and engagement strategies

  • Generate opportunities through industry networking, referrals, partnerships, and events

  • Continuously expand LimeFlight's presence within the airline industry

Commercial Leadership

  • Lead by example through active pipeline creation, opportunity management, and enterprise sales execution

  • Mentor and coach junior sales team members

  • Support deal reviews, account planning, and opportunity strategy

  • Share best practices for enterprise sales execution and stakeholder management

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales methodologies and commercial processes

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Founder teams

  • Coordinate internal resources throughout the sales cycle

  • Ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally

  • Support smooth transitions from sales into implementation and customer success

  • Act as the voice of the market and customer within LimeFlight

Key competencies

  • 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including significant experience selling to airlines

  • Proven track record of generating pipeline through strategic account-based selling

  • Demonstrated success selling enterprise software, SaaS, or technology solutions to large airline organizations

  • Track record of personally leading and closing enterprise opportunities with a combined contract value exceeding CHF 3 million

  • Experience managing six- and seven-figure enterprise sales opportunities

  • Strong understanding of airline buying processes, stakeholder management, and enterprise procurement

  • Ability to independently drive opportunities forward within complex stakeholder environments

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • Strong commercial and business acumen

  • Collaborative mindset with a team-first attitude

  • Passion for mentoring and developing others

  • High degree of ownership, accountability, and resilience

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience selling SaaS or enterprise software solutions to airlines.

  • Existing network within the airline industry

  • Deep understanding of airline operations and organizational structures

  • Experience selling across different global markets, with the ability to adapt sales strategies and stakeholder engagement approaches to regional business cultures and buying processes.

  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior commercial team members

Language

  • Fluent English required

  • Additional languages are a plus

Expected travel needs

You should be willing to travel up to 30% of the year for customer meetings, industry conferences, trade shows, and relationship-building activities.

Given the relationship-driven nature of the airline industry, regular face-to-face interactions are an important part of the role.

  • Be hands-on where it counts – Join strategic accounts and complex workshops yourself, and be the technical escalation point for customers and AEs.

  • Own the interfaces – Work closely with Sales leadership, Solutions Development and Product to keep handovers clean and expectations aligned.

  • Improve how we work – Shape the team’s processes, templates, tools and KPIs, and turn field insights into input for Product.

  • 5+ years in technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects, including 2+ years leading a team

  • You’ve run requirement workshops, won deals yourself and worked against a quota, so you know what it takes to hit it

  • You still enjoy being in front of customers and are credible with an engineer on the shop floor and a plant manager deciding on the investment

  • You build structure that helps the team move faster, not process for its own sake

  • You speak German and English fluently

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Experience building or scaling a team in a fast-growing company is a plus

  • A background at a robot manufacturer or system integrator is a plus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Dabei arbeitest du selbst operativ mit und verantwortest korrekte HGB-Abschlüsse für alle Gesellschaften und für die Gruppe. Du berichtest direkt an den CFO. Unsere Gruppe wächst durch Zukäufe, und was du aufbaust, muss mit diesem Tempo mithalten. Du entscheidest, wie Rechnungswesen bei Buena funktioniert.

Was du tun wirst

  • Aufbau. Du baust ein zentrales Rechnungswesen für alle deutschen Gesellschaften Schritt für Schritt auf. Dafür legst du Zielbild und Roadmap fest, übernimmst Aufgaben von externen Dienstleistern und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit ihnen.

  • Prüfer und Berater. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Wirtschaftsprüfer und Steuerberater und setzt Prüfungsfeststellungen um.

  • Team. Du baust das Team Schritt für Schritt auf und entscheidest, welche Aufgaben intern bleiben und welche extern vergeben werden.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn

  • Du hast Konzernabschlüsse nach HGB selbst erstellt, nicht nur koordiniert oder geprüft, am besten in einer Gruppe mit vielen Gesellschaften.

  • Du bist LucaNet-Experte und hast eine Konsolidierung dort selbst neu aufgesetzt, von der Datenübernahme aus DATEV bis zum Reporting.

  • Du beherrschst DATEV bis in die Tiefe und hast viele Mandanten mit einheitlicher Struktur aufgesetzt und geführt.

  • Du hast ein Rechnungswesen mit Prozessen und Systemen selbst aufgebaut, nicht nur verbessert.

  • Du hast ein Team aufgebaut und geführt.

  • Du erkennst Fehler in Einzelabschlüssen, bevor sie in die Konsolidierung laufen.

  • Du warst bei Abschlussprüfungen erste Ansprechperson und hast Feststellungen umgesetzt.

  • Du arbeitest schnell und genau, auch unter Abschlussdruck.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

What we offer

  • Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Who will I report to? Our VP Engineering. The role is sponsored by our CPTO: the frontend platform is one of the CPTO's top priorities, you agree the target architecture and migration roadmap together, and the CPTO holds your final interview.

Which tech stack will I work with? React and TypeScript on both products. FactFinder NG runs on a Java backend, Infinity on .NET/F# (with Fable/Feliz on the frontend). Backend, F# and our search domain are things you can learn here – React expertise, Web Components, design-system architecture and AI-first practice are what you bring from day one.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Two legacy frontends on Java and .NET – isn't that painful? That's exactly the mandate: unify them, and how is your call. Incremental, not big-bang.

Can I work fully remote? No – the role is hybrid with 2–3 office days per week at one of our offices.

Why eCommerce search? Because agentic commerce is where AI meets real purchase decisions – on our platform that's 2,000+ shops and €160+ billion in GMV a year.

Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile plus links to work you're proud of (GitHub, a design system, a talk, a blog post) – and tell us in three sentences how you use AI in your daily engineering work. No cover letter needed.

Your contact: Mirko Duus
