title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. 1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

What we're looking for

Must have

  • PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

  • Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Freelance
description:
Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. · Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. title: Senior Radiochemist

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

  • Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
  • cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.
  • Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.
  • Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.
  • Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.
  • Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.
  • Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety:

  • Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards
  • Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

The candidates we are looking for must have:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.
  • Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.
  • In-depth understanding of radiochemistry processes, equipment and tools.
  • Mastery of characterization, alpha or gamma spectrometry, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, liquid scintillation counting, or comparable analytical techniques.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of safety, radioprotection and GMP regulations and requirements. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders across disciplines. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges.
  • Proven experience in translating lab-scale processes to GMP production line would be an asset
  • Fluent in English. Excellent knowledge of French or German would be an asset

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

title: Quality Officer
description:
Bij Crisp willen we beter eten mogelijk maken voor meer mensen. Dat begint met eten waar je op kunt vertrouwen: veilig, hygiënisch en elke keer net zo goed als we beloven. Daarom zorg jij ervoor dat kwaliteit, hygiëne en voedselveiligheid op de productievloer elke dag kloppen. Je bent onze ogen en oren op de vloer. Het fundament staat als een huis: HACCP, kwaliteit en specificatiebeheer zijn op orde. Jij zorgt dat de praktijk daar dagelijks bij aansluit en je stuurt bij waar het nodig is. Je bent veel op de productievloer te vinden voor controles en om processen te verifiëren. Af en toe zit je in ons eigen lab voor experimenten en testen.

Wat deze rol zo leuk maakt? Je hebt direct invloed op ons product en je zit er altijd dichtbij. Schuurt het ergens op kwaliteit, dan ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor de productie. Klachten pak je grondig op en je zoekt praktische oplossingen.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je loopt dagelijks kwaliteits- en hygiënerondes op de productievloer. Je controleert of collega’s de werkwijzen en kwaliteitsstandaarden naleven.

  • Je neemt monsters en doet snelle producttesten en metingen, zoals pH en temperatuur. Ook controleer je inkomende grondstoffen en inkoopartikelen.

  • Je voert gerichte controle- en testprogramma’s uit op smaak, microbiologie, chemie, fysieke eigenschappen en allergenen, bij processen, grondstoffen en eindproducten.

  • Je coördineert en interpreteert laboratoriumonderzoeken (M/C/F/A) en voert houdbaarheidsstudies uit.

  • Je coördineert en zet smaaktesten en proeverijen in.

  • Je onderzoekt klachten van klanten over producten grondig. Je duikt de productie in, achterhaalt waar het misging en borgt de oplossing.

  • Je let op de juiste toepassing van onze vaste productspecificaties en etiketteringseisen tijdens de productie.

  • Je controleert, test en kalibreert meet- en weegapparatuur.

  • Je spreekt productiemedewerkers aan, coacht ze en geeft korte, praktische trainingen en instructies, bijvoorbeeld over hygiëne en allergenen. Zo tillen we de voedselveiligheidscultuur elke dag naar een hoger niveau.

Dit ben jij

  • Je bent praktisch en zichtbaar. Je zit niet graag hele dagen achter een bureau. Jij bent op je best op de productievloer.

  • Je bent een goede communicator en coach. Je legt kwaliteitsregels helder uit en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, opbouwende manier aan als iemand zich er niet aan houdt.

  • Je bent kritisch en nauwkeurig. Je let op details, kijkt scherp naar het proces en neemt geen genoegen met half werk.

  • Je bent zelfredzaam en oplossingsgericht. Je pakt zaken zelf op, weet bij wie je moet zijn en komt je afspraken na.

  • Je bent flexibel. Loopt je dag op de vloer anders door een kwaliteitsprobleem of een urgente klacht? Dan schakel je snel en pas je je prioriteiten aan.

  • Je hebt minimaal MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je hebt gedegen basiskennis van levensmiddelen (microbiologie, chemie en allergenen). Je weet hoe kruisbesmetting werkt en kunt labuitslagen interpreteren.

  • Je kent de basis van HACCP, de hygiënecode, algemene warenwetgeving en GFSI-normen, zoals BRCGS, IFS of FSSC 22000.

  • Pre: een opleiding in Levensmiddelentechnologie, Voedingskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.

Zo houd je de kosten in de hand, zorg je dat we leveren wat we beloven en help je ons groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je leidt de dagstart, verdeelt het werk en stelt prioriteiten. Bij vertraging of een storing stuur je bij.

  • Je loopt zichtbaar rond op de vloer en bent het aanspreekpunt voor operators, technische dienst en kwaliteitsmedewerkers.

  • Je stuurt teamleiders, operators en ondersteunende diensten aan op resultaat.

  • Je draagt een cultuur uit van veiligheid, discipline, openheid en verantwoordelijkheid, en bewaakt die.

  • Je zet samen met het team verbeteracties op en voert ze door: de OEE omhoog, omsteltijden korter, minder verspilling.

  • Je houdt de belangrijkste cijfers bij en analyseert ze: output, rendement, verspilling en afkeur. Je rapporteert aan de directie en doet voorstellen op basis van data.

  • Je borgt voedselveiligheid en kwaliteitsnormen. Je controleert de kwaliteitsregistraties, bewaakt hygiëne en HACCP en bereidt audits voor.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij audits, afwijkingen en escalaties.

  • Je regelt het operationele HR-werk: personeelsplanning, werving, inwerken, beoordelen en coachen van teamleden, zodat het team breed inzetbaar en betrokken blijft.

  • Je houdt overzicht over bestellingen van grondstoffen en verpakkingen, voorraad en capaciteit, en stemt af met inkoop, logistiek en andere afdelingen.

  • Je adviseert het management over investeringen, capaciteitsknelpunten en verbeterinitiatieven.

Dit ben jij

  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen details op de vloer en de grotere bedrijfsdoelen. Je handelt snel en denkt structureel.

  • Jij laat niets door de vingers glippen. Je borgt standaarden samen met je team, kent je CCP's en grijpt in bij risico's.

  • Je werkt met dashboards, rapportages en planningsdata en neemt beslissingen op basis van feiten, niet op gevoel.

  • Je zorgt voor rust, ritme en eigenaarschap. Collega's weten waar ze aan toe zijn en groeien met jouw begeleiding.

Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte.

  • Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift.

🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus

  • Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt: Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams.

  • Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft.

  • Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat.

🛟 Customer Support

  • Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen.

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

  • Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt: Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist.

  • Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte: Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert.

  • Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Was du selbst lösen kannst, löst du selbst.

  • Du testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen, und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess.

🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen

  • Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

Muss-Kriterien

  • Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet

  • Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten

Wie du arbeitest

  • AI-native: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine fundierte Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht den einzelnen Kunden, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu lösen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn die nächste Person versteht.

  • Technische Tiefe: Du gehst ins Produkt hinein: Daten prüfen, Flows nachvollziehen, Logs lesen, ein Problem sauber eingrenzen – und wo es geht, mit KI-Tools selbst beheben, sonst so beschreiben, dass es lösbar ist. Du fühlst dich in einer Software wohl, nicht nur in einer Präsentation darüber.

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

  • Kommerzieller Instinkt: Du erkennst den Moment, in dem aus einem zufriedenen Kunden ein größerer Kunde wird – und sprichst ihn an, statt zu warten.

Persönlicher Hintergrund

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt

  • Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience bei alago. Es gibt keinen bestehenden Bereich, in den du dich einfügst – du entscheidest, wie er aussieht: welche Prozesse, welche Tools, welche Standards, welche Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

alago wird von sechs, sieben Bereichen getragen. Customer Experience ist einer davon – und du besitzt ihn. Du sitzt bei den Entscheidungen am Tisch, die die Firma prägen, nicht nur bei denen über deine Kunden. Der Weg von hier führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team.

Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt

Die stärksten KI-Unternehmen der Welt suchen gerade händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt gleichzeitig beherrschen — bei Palantir heißt dieses Profil Forward Deployed Engineer, und es ist deshalb so wertvoll, weil es so selten ist. Bei uns wächst du genau in diese Richtung: Du lernst an echten Kunden, wie man Vertrauen aufbaut und schwierige Gespräche führt, und wie man einen Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert begleitet, statt ihn nach dem Onboarding sich selbst zu überlassen. title: (Senior) AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
What You'll Do

You’ll identify open AI opportunities, build them from start to finish, and bring them to real users. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you’ll work across our three product squads: You’ll single-handedly turn unaddressed topics into products, hand them off once they’re up and running, and serve as a sparring partner for the squad PMs on all AI-related topics. For us, “senior” refers to your approach to work, not your years of experience. You’ll report directly to Product Leadership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Independent AI projects (about half of your time)
  • You’ll identify high-impact AI opportunities in our legal workflows - in areas where no specific squad is responsible
  • Validation happens quickly: discussions with attorneys, Legal Ops, and insurers; prototypes built in days
  • You’ll bring the winning solutions into production yourself: routing, chaining, summarization, and agent-based loops
  • You’ll hand off mature features to the squad - complete with documentation, evaluations, and a handover plan
Support for the squads (the other half)
  • Feasibility, costs, model selection, risks: You’ll answer these questions before every AI feature is launched
  • You support the teams in designing evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails
  • You review concepts before they go into the roadmap - including prompt injection and compliance risks (GDPR, Section 203 of the German Criminal Code)
  • You advance AI best practices: prompt engineering standards, LLM observability, and agent-based coding workflows


What you bring

Must-have

  • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engineering (Git, testing, CI/CD, code review)
  • In-depth experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar - including an understanding of what’s happening under the hood
  • Proficiency with LLM provider APIs: function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming
  • Evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails before deployment
  • Solid prompt engineering - you know when to use which technique
  • Business-level English; German is a major plus due to our legal domain
Soft Skills
  • The maturity to work without a squad around you: You set your own priorities and know when to say no
  • You can explain a technical trade-off to a lawyer and a legal workflow to an engineer


What we promise

Work Environment & Flexibility

  • Office-first: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home - with flexibility in how you structure your work
  • Modern, air-conditioned office with plenty of natural light and a large rooftop terrace overlooking Berlin
  • Central location between Gleisdreieck and Potsdamer Platz
Benefits
  • Full coverage of the public-transport ticket
  • Company pension plan with a 20% employer contribution
  • Corporate benefits platform with discounts from many brands
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Regular company and team events, after-work fun with Switch, PS5, darts, and foosball
  • Free drinks, fresh fruit, and granola
Culture & Collaboration
  • Agile mindset with open communication - every voice counts
  • Feedback is part of our culture - we believe in growing together
Fast application process

  • Approx. 20-minute introductory conversation with our HR team

Bei Event Inc wollen wir Entscheidungen konsequent auf Basis von Daten treffen. Das gilt von der Go-to-Market-Strategie bis zur Conversion-Optimierung, in Marketing, Sales und Product. Mit Dir bündeln wir die Analysekompetenz an einer Stelle und schaffen eine gemeinsame Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können.

Deine Rolle

Als Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights bist Du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Datenanalysen entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bist Teil unseres Product Teams und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Data Engineers. Du begleitest Maßnahmen von der ersten Exploration über die Empfehlung bis zur Wirkungsmessung.

  • Performance im Blick: Du überwachst laufend unsere GTM-Performance über Marketing, Sales und Product hinweg, von Funnel-Analysen über Kanal-Performance bis zu Conversion-Raten.
  • Zahlen, die etwas bewegen: Du lieferst Ad-hoc-Analysen für unsere Teams, immer mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen statt reinen Reports.
  • Von der Idee bis zur Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst Du Hypothesen und übersetzt sie in Experimente und A/B-Tests. Mit Vorher-/Nachher-Vergleichen misst Du, ob Maßnahmen wirklich wirken.
  • Muster erkennen: Du machst Cohort- und Funnel-Analysen über Kundensegmente und Marketplace-Bereiche hinweg (z. B. Pharma vs. Automotive). Mit Win/Loss-Analysen bei Enterprise-Deals lieferst Du wertvollen Input für unser Sales Enablement.
  • Traffic-Kanäle optimieren: In enger Abstimmung mit Marketing, Sales und Product optimierst Du unsere Traffic-Kanäle, z. B. mit Blick auf SEO/GEO-Performance und Content-Wirkung.
  • Reporting smart automatisieren: Zusammen mit einem Data Engineer baust Du eine KI- und automatisierungsgestützte Reporting-Infrastruktur auf. So fließt Deine Zeit in Analyse und Empfehlung statt in manuelle Datenaufbereitung.
  • Schnittstelle mit Gewicht: Du bist die zentrale Datenquelle für GTM-Entscheidungen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CPO zusammen.

Was uns gefällt

  • Fundierte Basis: Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung in Data Science, Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Erfahrung, die zählt: Du bringst 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data, Business oder Product Analytics mit. Mit Marketing-, Sales- oder Marketplace-Funnel-Metriken und Tracking kennst Du Dich aus.
  • Analytisches Handwerkszeug: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und Statistik und weißt, wie man aussagekräftige KPIs entwickelt.
  • Daten in Klartext: Du leitest aus Zahlen konkrete, verständliche Empfehlungen ab und vermittelst sie so, dass jedes Team etwas damit anfangen kann.
  • Struktur, auch wenn's voll wird: Du arbeitest eigenständig und behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Teams gleichzeitig etwas von Dir brauchen.
  • Tech-Neugier: Du verstehst Code und schreibst ihn auch selbst (z. B. Python). Idealerweise hast Du schon mit Coding Agents Analysen erstellt oder automatisierte, KI-gestützte Reportings aufgebaut. Das ist kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus.

Was Dir gefällt

  • Teamspirit, der Spaß macht: Freu Dich auf ein motiviertes, hochqualifiziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt. Dazu gibt's regelmäßige Teamevents wie Afterwork-Drinks auf der Dachterrasse, Culture Nights oder Spieleabende.
  • Sei ein Sparfuchs: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf Top-Marken und Reisen über PepXpress und Corporate Benefits.
  • Gut versorgt: Natürlich stehen Dir der obligatorische Obstkorb, eine Müslibar sowie kalte und warme Getränke jederzeit zur Verfügung.

  • Arbeitszeiten: Unsere Kernarbeitszeit ist von 10 bis 17 Uhr. Den Rest gestaltest Du nach Deinem Rhythmus.
  • Büro mit Wow-Faktor: Du arbeitest mit Blick auf die Elbe und einige der schönsten Sehenswürdigkeiten Hamburgs.
  • Pick your Perk: Du wählst 20 € Benefitsy, 20 € Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder 20 € Zuschuss für Urban Sports.

We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role.

 

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

 

The Team You Will Lead 

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. 

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

  • On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
  • Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. 
  • Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
  • Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

 

The Operational Reality

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

  • Context Switching is the Norm
    • You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
  • Agility over Silos
    • Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
  • Focus Management
    • Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.

 

As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will:

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Team Management
    • Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management.
  • Formal Training & Growth
    • Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports.
  • Recruitment & Retention
    • Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture.
  • Culture of Learning
    • Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.

Strategic & Operational Management

  • Budget & Capacity Planning
    • Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.
  • Risk & Contingency
    • Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.
  • Procedure & Frameworks
    • Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.
  • Prioritisation
    • Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations.

Technical Support & Oversight

    • Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them.
  • Visual Documentation
    • Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Remote (UK-based), with occasional on-site work at our data centres | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 50+ of the world’s leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what’s technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help run and grow the network and cloud estate behind our trading platform. Networking in our colocation data centres is the core of the role. The estate spans London, New York and Singapore, and from Q1 2027 a new Tokyo data centre.

This is a hands-on role in a small, expert infrastructure team. You’ll work closely with our Head of Infrastructure, following problems from the cross-connect through hosts, containers and AWS. You’ll also help keep infrastructure delivery on track, from timelines and reporting to working closely with our TechOps team.

What You’ll Work On

  • Low-latency networking across our colocation sites: switching and routing, cross-connects, BGP peering with liquidity providers and clients, and the fabric that carries our trading traffic

  • Bringing new sites to application-ready, starting with Tokyo

  • Our hybrid connectivity into multi-region AWS, including Direct Connect, routing and failover

  • Linux hosts and containers on the critical path, with every change made through code (Ansible, Git, Terraform), never by hand

  • Monitoring and alerting that catches problems before clients do, plus runbooks and post-incident reviews that someone else can follow

  • Planning and capacity: forecasting growth, setting timelines and reporting progress to TechOps and engineering

What We Need

  • 4+ years running production infrastructure in a latency-sensitive environment, such as HFT, an exchange, market data or bank trading infrastructure

  • Strong networking: hands-on routing and switching (MLAG, LACP, VLANs), BGP in production, and a solid grasp of low-latency behaviour such as buffers, microbursts and congestion handling

  • Colocation experience: cabinets, cross-connects, remote hands and vendor management

  • Solid Linux (RHEL) and TCP/IP, and the ability to trace a problem from the wire to the application

  • Infrastructure as code and containers as your default way of working

  • Working knowledge of AWS networking, and the confidence to pick up the rest of our stack. Networking depth matters more to us than any particular cloud or platform tooling

  • Methodical, evidence-led troubleshooting and clear documentation

A strong plus:

  • Project management experience: owning timelines, reporting progress, and working with ops teams to hit deadlines

  • Kernel bypass (Onload/ef_vi), PTP and time synchronisation

  • Experience bringing up a new colo site

  • FIX protocol or OTC FX market knowledge

  • Python for tooling

Working pattern: Infrastructure changes are often scheduled outside trading hours, including weekends, and the team shares an on-call rota. We’re a team with flexible hours, so time worked out of hours is taken back during the week. Day-to-day work is remote, with occasional visits to our data centres, most often in London (Slough).

What You Get

  • Real ownership of a live global trading network, hands-on, with few layers of process

  • A build-out year, with a new Tokyo data centre in Q1 and more growth ahead

  • A senior seat in a small, expert team where your changes ship and are measured

  • Competitive package — up to 38 days leave (inc. bank holidays), private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly working with flexibility around out-of-hours work

  • Growth as the estate scales

We believe in transparency, honest feedback and writing things down, and we aim to build systems that don’t depend on the heroics of individuals.

title: Data Scientist - Broker Flow
description:
Data Scientist - Broker Flow Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Broker Flow team.

You'll own the experiments that shape the journey brokers use to apply on their clients' behalf. Brokers are one of iwoca's main routes to new customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Broker Flow, a new team in iwoca's third-party acquisition department, owns the journey for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – from before they apply to a completed credit assessment. Its aim is to get more of those businesses to an offer. Broker Terms, a separate team, then sets the price, amount, and duration of each offer.

The team works on three parts of that journey:

  • Broker engagement. Working with brokers and their clients before an application starts.

  • The application. Making it smooth to complete, and collecting the data a credit decision needs.

  • Operations. Running the CRM tools iwoca's teams work in, and automating operational processes.

The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use.

The role

As the Data Scientist in Broker Flow, you'll give the team the evidence behind its product decisions. The core of the work is experiment design and causal inference, with modelling and analysis alongside it.

You'll own each project end to end. You'll frame the problem, choose the method, build the model or run the test, and take the answer to the commercial and strategy colleagues who act on it. You'll also meet brokers in person, which gives you the context to ask the right questions. The team is new, so its methods are yours to shape. You'll see the effect of your work in how many businesses reach an offer, and in their lifetime value.

You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other broker and partner teams, and join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – to compare methods and build your expertise. Your results reach the wider business through Learnings, short write-ups that iwoca shares at weekly and fortnightly sessions.

Live project examples:

  • Refinancing. Modelling which businesses would benefit from refinancing their existing borrowing, and testing a product for them.

  • Stalled applications. Finding where broker applications stall, and testing fixes – from clearer emails and portal updates to an early offer that encourages document upload.

  • Reintroductions. Testing the best moment for brokers to bring existing iwoca customers back to borrow.

  • Approval probability. Measuring how well the estimate brokers see in the Introducer Portal predicts actual credit decisions, and making it more accurate.

  • Measuring impact. Designing early signals – at sign-up and once documents are in – that predict a business's lifetime value, so the team can judge its changes quickly.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You've separated signal from noise in observational and experimental data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them.

  • Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling.

  • Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: AI Support Engineer Lead
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

 

At Dust, we're building for a new kind of AI Operator: people who rethink and rebuild how their teams work around AI. Not “how can AI help us do this faster?” but “if AI existed from day one, would we even do this the same way?”

 

As our AI Support Engineering Lead, you'll own how Support is built and scaled at Dust. This is a deeply hands-on role. You'll take on the hardest customer issues when our agents fall short, but your job isn't simply to resolve them. You'll look for the pattern behind each issue and turn what you learn into better agents, automation, tooling, documentation, and product improvements. Over time, you'll help grow the team and shape how Support Engineering operates as Dust scales.

 

You'll define, ship, and continuously iterate on the systems that make this possible: AI agents, automation workflows, classification systems, knowledge systems, and tooling built on top of Dust itself. You'll dogfood the product harder than almost anyone at the company and set the standard for how the rest of the Support Engineering team does the same.

 

We're looking for someone who wants to lead from the work: technically strong, obsessed with building better systems, and excited to shape both the team and the function as we grow.

 

What you'll do

 

Build the AI systems that do the work

  • Set the technical direction for the support stack: what gets automated, in what order, and to what standard. You make the calls, not just the builds.

  • Design, ship, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that reduce manual support load: think ticket classification, acknowledgment automation, response drafting, incident detection, and proactive user outreach.

  • Identify recurring categories of issues and engineer them out of existence through automation, documentation, prompt iteration, or product feedback.

  • Build and maintain tooling (MCP integrations, Dust agents, internal scripts) that increase the team's capacity without increasing headcount.

  • Define and own the "Support as a Product" backlog. You decide what goes on it, coach the team to execute it, and hold the bar on what shipped means.

 

Run support when the systems fall short

  • Hire, onboard, and develop the support engineers around you. You're not just resolving tickets and building systems, you're growing the people who will.

  • Set the standard for how complex issues get handled at Dust. You take the hardest tickets yourself. The team knows what good looks like because they've watched you do it.

  • Investigate complex issues across logs, code, and internal tooling to identify root causes and provide clear answers to customers.

  • Handle escalated cases with precise, accessible communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Systematically analyze agent-generated responses for inconsistencies and iterate on prompts, documentation, and tooling until human intervention is minimal.

 

Bridge customer pain to product improvements

  • Represent support at the engineering and product level. You synthesize signal, prioritize it, and push it through with enough context that it actually moves things, not just relays it.

  • Build strong working relationships with engineers and customer-facing teams to ensure efficient, high-context escalations.

  • Own the feedback loop end-to-end: when agents fail due to missing or incorrect information, close the gap across engineering, product, and documentation.

 

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

 

Aptitude

  • Function-building experience: You've defined or significantly shaped a support engineering function before: built the operating model, set the standards, hired into the team, or rebuilt a broken process from scratch.

  • High technical aptitude: comfortable reading code, analyzing logs, navigating codebases, and troubleshooting distributed systems. You're not stopped by a stack trace.

  • AI fluency at builder level: track record of building custom agents, automations, or workflows using AI tools (Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, etc.); not just prompting.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, what to escalate, and, critically, what to delegate and to whom. You make these calls for yourself and for the team, fast and without second-guessing.

  • People leadership: You've coached and developed engineers and know how to set expectations, give direct feedback, and raise the performance of the people around you.

  • Bidirectional communication: can translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and speak technical language fluently with engineers.

  • Build/Run mindset: You believe the best Support Engineering teams don't just resolve issues. They build systems that prevent those issues from recurring.

 

Attitude

  • Builder mentality: You instinctively automate repetitive work rather than accepting inefficient systems, and you hold your team to the same standard.

  • Resilience-empathy paradox: You can absorb customer frustration without taking it personally while still deeply caring about the user experience.

  • Leads by example: You're not above the queue. When something is hard, you take it.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, and what to escalate.

  • Thrives in ambiguity: You enjoy building systems from scratch in environments where many processes are still undefined.

  • Low ego, team player: You share knowledge freely and care about the success of the broader team.

 

Agency

  • High ownership: You define what needs to be done as often as you execute it. You don't wait for someone to tell you the function has a gap.

  • Systems-first thinking: You focus on eliminating categories of work, not simply resolving tickets faster. You hold yourself and the team accountable to that distinction.

  • Pattern recognition to repeatability: You turn recurring issues into scalable systems, automations, workflows, or documentation that eliminate future occurrences.

  • Deep investigation instincts: You investigate as far as possible before escalating, providing engineering teams with thoughtful, high-context information when collaboration is needed, and you coach the team to do the same.

 

Even if you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We care deeply about curiosity, potential, and determination, and we know exceptional people don’t always fit neatly into a checklist.

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive compensation based on level and experience

    • 100,000€ - 160,000€

  • Significant equity package at a Sequoia-backed startup

  • Health benefits for you and your dependents

  • New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc.

  • Opportunity to travel between our Paris and San Francisco offices

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

About Us

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Kernel Software Engineer, you own the low-level software platform that sits between our hardware and the flight application on our ground control stations. You work across the Linux kernel, board support and a custom Android build, so that every control, display and data link works reliably in the field. You are the bridge between our hardware and application teams, taking a new product line from board bring-up to mass production.

Responsibilities

  • Bring up, configure and maintain the Linux kernel on our hardware, including device tree, drivers and security patches.

  • Customize and maintain our Android build, covering system services, permissions, boot sequence and OTA updates.

  • Integrate controls, display, touch, battery and radio modules, and expose them cleanly to the application layer.

  • Ensure robust, low-latency SBUS and MAVLink data flows between the controller, the radio and the drone.

  • Debug hardware and software issues alongside electronics and mechanical engineers, using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and UART/JTAG.

  • Define flashing, provisioning, factory test and release procedures with the production team.

  • Work with QGroundControl engineers and QA to validate system behavior on real hardware.

  • Join field tests and flight sessions to validate your work in real conditions.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in embedded software development.

  • Strong command of the Linux kernel (configuration, device tree, drivers, debugging) and of C; C++ is a plus.

  • Hands-on background customizing AOSP, from HALs and system services to the build system.

  • Comfortable at the hardware boundary: UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, USB, display and touch controllers.

  • Exposure to drones or robotics, including MAVLink or PX4/ArduPilot, is a plus.

  • Hands-on, autonomous and pragmatic, with curiosity about hardware and the ability to learn quickly.

  • Professional English for technical documentation and international collaboration.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications.
Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors.

title: Communications Lead
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

Yubo doesn't have a PR team yet, and that's exactly why this role exists: to build one from scratch and help Yubo become culturally relevant, resilient to reputational bumps, and a real driver of growth.

It's a rare chance to shape a PR function from day one inside a fast-moving global tech company. You'll design how it works, lead our agency partner, and craft the stories, moments and relationships that make people pay attention to Yubo. The role covers everyday consumer stories, corporate communications, and handling sensitive issues or crises when they arise. To start, you'll focus on the US, UK and France, with room to grow from there.

You'll report to the Director of Brand & Communications and work closely with teams across the business, especially Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal. You'll own the relationship with our PR agency, making sure they feel like a true extension of the team, and you'll help set up the habits and processes that make PR part of how Yubo works day to day.

This is a freelance role on a 6-month contract, with a target start in Q4 2026.

Your responsibilites

Set up how PR works at Yubo

  • Build PR operations and onboard Yubo's PR agency, setting clear ways to spot stories, check facts, and turn insight into coverage.

  • Dig into Yubo's data to find trends and stories worth telling.

  • Build a simple way to report on PR performance, linking coverage and sentiment to awareness and growth.

  • Review and embed Yubo's Crisis Comms Playbook.

Plan and run the PR agenda

  • Build Yubo's 2027 PR calendar and strategy, balancing campaigns, cultural moments, and day-to-day press activity.

  • Lead proactive and reactive media relations so Yubo speaks with a clear, consistent voice.

  • Spot and activate cultural moments through PR, research, events, creator partnerships and other earned activity.

  • Team up with Product and Data to build proof points and stories that show what Yubo means to people.

Look after Yubo's reputation

  • Advise senior leaders on reputational opportunities and risks.

  • Support corporate communications and reactive issues management when needed.

  • Work with Trust & Safety and Legal so Yubo talks about sensitive topics responsibly.

  • Help rally the right people internally when a crisis hits.

Who you are

You're a proactive PR lead with sharp cultural instincts and a track record of creating stories that genuinely earn attention, not just promote launches.

You'll bring:

  • Solid PR experience, with real results to show from leading a function or campaign.

  • A good read on Gen-Z culture and how 18 to 24 year-olds socialise and engage online.

  • Experience turning insight and data into media stories, including digging into data yourself to find the angle.

  • A track record of using different levers to earn attention: influencers, experts, events, activations, research, stunts.

  • Experience managing and getting the best out of an external PR agency.

  • Good judgement under pressure, with experience in issues or crisis communications.

  • Strong writing and speaking skills, comfortable with both consumer storytelling and sensitive corporate messaging.

  • The ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

  • A self-starter mindset, with examples of building something from the ground up.

Nice to have, but don't let that stop you:

  • Experience in high-growth tech, consumer apps, youth culture, media, entertainment or lifestyle.

  • Experience in the US market, including relationships with US media and journalists.

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, mission and community, and where our communications and reputation stand today.

  • Meet key people across Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal.

  • Start onboarding our PR agency and reviewing the Crisis Comms Playbook.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Have set up solid working habits with the PR agency and cross-functional teams.

  • Be well into building the 2027 PR strategy, calendar and measurement framework.

  • Have embedded the Crisis Comms Playbook and be actively building relationships with consumer, culture, lifestyle, tech and business media.

Within 6 months, you will

  • Have delivered Yubo's finished 2027 PR strategy and calendar.

  • Have landed our first standout data- and culture-led stories in top-tier media, backed by a working way to measure PR performance.

  • Have wrapped up the agency onboarding and defined the role of creators, experts, events and activations in Yubo's communications, leaving a solid foundation for what's next.

The recruitment process

  • A first introductory call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

  • A case study with Alex, our Brand Director.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

description:
You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.

This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

What success looks like

Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

What you’ll be doing

  • Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference

  • Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed

  • Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes

  • Managing capacity with our cloud providers

  • Debugging failures in GPUs, Linux, storage and networking

The first year

By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

Who you’ll work with

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

What we think it takes

You’re likely a good fit if you:

  • Have built and run GPU workloads on Kubernetes

  • Could design a GPU cluster for training and online RL from scratch

  • Debug confidently at the OS layer and below (Linux, GPU drivers, networking and storage)

  • Write strong Python

It’s a plus if you’ve worked as an SRE or infrastructure engineer, or have used:

  • Slurm

  • Kubernetes scheduling and autoscaling tools such as Kueue or Karpenter

  • Multi-cloud orchestration tools such as SkyPilot

  • AWS services such as EKS or SageMaker HyperPod

  • High-performance interconnects and collective communication libraries such as EFA, InfiniBand, NCCL or Open MPI

  • Terraform

You don’t need ML research experience. If you match most of this but not every point, please apply.

How we hire

Four stages, about three hours in total: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering. The coding and system design interviews are modelled on real-world problems you’d face in this role.

Practicalities

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office and occasional travel between the two. We offer a competitive package.
