title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
OWNS

The technical outcome of NIX ANGELS: the line, the roadmap, the technical team, the technical budget, and the credibility of our technical claims in front of investors and funding bodies.

REPORTS TO

CEO / Founder. Peer to COO and Head of Design. Member of the leadership team.

TEAM

3-5 full-time engineers.

WHO WE ARE

NIX is working towards a fully automated clothing production line in Europe. We’re starting with the simplest, most challenging product: a cotton jersey T-shirt. By the end of April 2027, our production line is expected to produce 5–10 shirts per day, with fewer than two manual interventions per shirt. A key problem with our production line remains unsolved: holding, stretching, and securing fabric that sags while a machine sews.

If that sounds like the most interesting problem in manufacturing and robotics, it is probably exactly the right one for you.

WHAT YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR

  1. The production line and the roadmap. The milestones are set against one target: a proof of concept by April 2027, 5–10 shirts per day. The roadmap states milestones, blockers and gates. We want you to challenge every aspect of it — and to build the line against those targets.

  2. Digital Transformation: Drive Industry 4.0 initiatives like IoT, AI-driven predictive maintenance, and automation on the factory floor.

  3. The technical team: hiring, leading, developing. You set the standard and you protect the focus.

  4. Design for automation: negotiating with Product and Design which garment features stay, which ones change, and what a future style must respect to be machine-makeable.

  5. Suppliers and partners: finding them, qualifying them, negotiating. Supplier acquisition is a core skill here.

  6. Finance: technical budget, cost breakdowns, CapEx versus OpEx, and estimates that survive being challenged. You build and defend the technical part of our funding case.

  7. Investors and public funding: technical due diligence, and the technical substance behind the grant applications our advisor is writing.

  8. Machine safety and CE: you own the risk assessments and the conformity of what we build, with external safety engineering support.

  9. IP: what we protect, what we publish, what we deliberately leave open.

  10. Research partnerships with universities and institutes — scoped, time-boxed, with a specific research question under investigation.

WHAT YOU MUST BRING

TEXTILES AND MATERIALS

Knowledge of textile technology, garment manufacturing and material behaviour. Without it, show us that you learn a new material domain extremely fast — and how you did that before. Ideally B.Eng./ M.Eng/M.Sc. in Textile Engineering /Mechanical Engineering /Robotics Engineering

SYSTEMS THINKING

You see the line as one system. You can explain why a decision at the cutting table shows up as a defect at the hem — and you can put a number on it.

HANDS-ON ENGINEERING

Automation, mechanical engineering and robotics, from your own hands. You will be in the workshop, at the machine, with fabric in your hands.

SPEED WITH A STEADY HAND

High cadence, quick decisions, 80 % information is enough to act. And at the same time calm — because a team that is rushed stops iterating and starts hiding problems. Urgency without panic.

BIAS TO ACTION

You would rather build a rough prototype this week than write a specification.

COMFORT WITH UNCERTAINTY

A core problem of our line is unsolved. You must be able to work, decide and lead a team without knowing whether it will work — and to stop a line of work honestly when the evidence says stop.

LEADERSHIP WITH EMPATHY

Proven experience leading engineers. People stay and grow under you. You give direct feedback and help them grow.

MONEY LITERACY

Budgeting, cost models, estimate quality, runway awareness. You know what your decisions cost per month.

LANGUAGES

German and English, both negotiating levels. The team is international; our suppliers and machine builders are largely German-speaking.

PRESENCE

Berlin, on site. This is a hardware company — the work happens at the machine. We do not run this role remotely.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

  • You want to lead technology from a laptop. The line is physical and so is this job.

  • You need consensus before you move.

  • You want certainty about the outcome. Nobody can give it to us, including you.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • True decision-making autonomy in your area, including the freedom to make mistakes.

  • A budget for tools and materials so the work can be done properly.

  • Short lines of communication, direct contact with the founder and industry partners.

  • Full support and a proper hand-over from the current CTO.

SELECTION PROCESS FOR THIS ROLE

  1. Screening call, 30 minutes: your credentials, our challenge, our expectations.

  2. A case study in our workshop: you see the real state, talk to the team, and work through the cost model and the roadmap with us.

  3. References from engineers who reported to you, and from people you reported to.

  4. Dinner with the team and the founder.

  5. Decision within one week after the workshop day.

Submit your application with everything that shows what you have built: photos, drawings, a repository, logs. We don’t need a cover letter. Three sentences on why this problem interests you are worth more. Without proof of what you have built, we will not review the application.

In your first months, you will establish clear priorities with the team, take ownership of the most important systems and deliver improvements that business teams can see and use.

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We’re growing fast! We’re a team of around 200 in 4 locations, and we’re looking for someone to help keep our people processes running smoothly as we scale.

You’ll be the go-to person for employee questions and the engine behind our day-to-day People ops, from onboarding and contracts to HRIS data and compliance. You won’t just be running processes, you’ll be building them too, so there’s real ownership and lots of room to make things better. It’s a broad, hands-on role, and it’s perfect for you if you’re organised, curious, and love making things work seamlessly behind the scenes.

What you’ll be doing

  • Admin: Looking after onboarding, offboarding, contracts and changes, probation, and leave and absence across all countries

  • Compliance: Overseeing background screening, and keeping our policies up to date as employment laws change

  • HRIS and data: Keeping HiBob accurate and tidy, and building workflows that cut down on manual admin

  • Payroll: Coordinating compensation and payroll-related administration with the Finance team, including employee query resolution

  • Benefits: Managing enrolment, changes, and employee queries across benefits programmes

  • Employee support: Being the first point of contact for questions on policies, processes, benefits and systems, and knowing when to sort things yourself and when to escalate

  • Self-serve and AI: Helping us build our People knowledge base in Confluence from the ground up so everyone can find answers fast, and exploring smart ways to use AI and automation to take the busywork out of People ops

  • Projects: Getting stuck into People initiatives as we grow, from performance and engagement cycles in Culture Amp to policy rollouts and process improvements

What you’ll need

  • 2–4 years in People Ops, HR Ops or an HR Generalist role, ideally in fintech or somewhere fast-growing

  • Good working knowledge of UK employment law

  • Hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle

  • Some exposure to employee relations, such as supporting cases, taking notes or tracking issues through to resolution

  • Experience with a multi-country team, or the ability to pick up local nuances quickly and work across time zones

  • Experience using an HRIS (bonus points for HiBob), and you’re comfortable with Excel

  • A real eye for detail and the organisation to juggle lots of requests without dropping the ball

  • Discretion and good judgement with confidential info and sensitive situations

  • Clear, friendly communication with everyone from new joiners to senior leaders

  • A helpful, reliable approach, and a habit of always looking for a better way to do things

title: Data Science Lead
description:
Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organizations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., UAE, Singapore and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

 

Do you want to lead a data science team on a problem the industry has not solved yet, while still writing code yourself? Are you excited about building the data foundation for how compliance works when the customer is an autonomous agent rather than a person? Are you looking for a values led company where a small team is trusted with a question that matters commercially in months, not years?

 

The impact you will have:

You will lead data science inside Elliptic's Intelligence team, alongside Intelligence Collection, Research and Investigations, and Professional Services. This is deliberately a player-coach role with a prospect of scaling a team. At first you will lead a small team of data scientists and you are expected to own the team's direction, performance and growth. You will own the evidence for the models your team builds, and you will represent them at Elliptic's model risk governance forum. This is not a compliance tax bolted onto the technical work: it is the reason institutions trust our outputs.

The reason we are hiring a lead as we add more data scientists is that a small team working on an unsolved problem needs someone who intrinsically understands the domain, not a layer of management above it. You will set what this team works on, hire the next people into it, and be the person whose technical judgement the team trusts because you can do the work yourself.

 

What you will do:

  • Lead and grow the team. Set objectives with your data scientists in the context of company strategy, own their performance and development, and be the manager who has the difficult conversation rather than deferring it. Level the team against Elliptic's Intelligence career framework and build real development paths.

  • Hire the next data scientists. Own the hiring process end to end with support: levels, job descriptions, hiring plan, interview panel and bar, and the hiring decision. Team growth to seven to nine people over time depends on you getting this right early.

  • Build the collection for the future of compliance. Take it from a directive to a specification to delivered data: define what good looks like, sequence the work, set the quality bar, and be honest about what the dataset does and does not support.

  • Own model governance for your team's models. Keep the model inventory current and correctly tiered, make sure validation and testing evidence exists at the standard each tier requires, monitor for drift and act on threshold breaches, and submit material changes and production deployments for review with the testing artefacts attached. Own the remediation of issues raised against your models, to agreed deadlines.

  • Lead Elliptic's data science work. Frame the research question, run the first experiments, and form a defensible view of what Elliptic needs to be able to do and by when. Bring that view to Intelligence leadership, the Chief Scientist and Product as a recommendation rather than as an open question.

  • Stay technically hands on. Write code, review your team's work at the level of method rather than output, and make the method calls yourself when they matter.

  • Own the team's existing commitments. The team's current work on clustering, attribution, heuristics and labelling continues to serve the platform. You own its reliability and its trade offs, and you decide what to stop.

  • Work across functions. Partner with Intelligence Collection, Collection Engineering, Research and Investigations, the Chief Scientist, Product and Engineering, so that data science work lands as platform capability rather than as analysis nobody uses.

  • Set the AI working standard for the team. Decide how your team uses AI in its engineering and research workflow, what must be verified and how, and hold the team to it.

 

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • The collection plan delivered at a scale that supports real model or heuristic work, with a documented path to maintaining it.

  • An agreed Elliptic position on the evolution of compliance systems, timed against expected industry demand, with the first capability work either underway or deliberately deferred with stated reasons.

  • At least one data science hire made, and the existing levelled against the career framework with development plans in place.

  • Model governance in good standing for everything your team owns: inventory current and correctly tiered, no overdue validations on the highest tiers, monitoring in place with acted-upon thresholds, and no open issues past their remediation deadline.

  • Data science objectives for Intelligence agreed and delivering, with other functions able to state what they can expect from the team and when.

  • A visible improvement in the reliability or throughput of the team's core output, attributable to a change you made.

  • Technical credibility intact: the team takes your method judgements seriously because you can do the work.

 

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Want to lead a team without leaving the technical work behind, and can say honestly where you draw that line.

  • Are comfortable being accountable for a question nobody has answered yet, including for saying what you do not know.

  • Treat management as the work rather than as overhead: objectives, feedback, development and difficult conversations included.

  • Treat governance as part of building good models rather than as paperwork that follows them, and would rather surface a problem with your own model than have someone else find it.

  • Are pragmatic about trade offs between rigour and speed, and can explain the trade off you chose.

  • Make other teams more effective rather than treating them as consumers of your team's output.

  • Are curious about how the company operates beyond your own function.

  • Care about the mission of using intelligence to fight financial crime and protect the global financial system.

 

Our ideal candidate has:

  • AI fluency, which is essential for this role. You must be able to demonstrate how you apply AI tools and approaches within a data science workflow: writing and debugging code, exploring unfamiliar data, accelerating pipeline and model work, and automating repetitive tasks. You must also be able to show how you critically evaluate the output, where you would not rely on it, and how you set verification expectations for a team rather than only for yourself. This is assessed in a dedicated stage of the interview process, working with your own tooling.

  • Demonstrated experience managing data scientists or machine learning engineers: setting objectives, owning performance including underperformance, and developing people. You can point to someone whose career changed because of how you managed them.

  • Experience hiring into a technical team, including defining the bar rather than only sitting on panels.

  • Deep, hands on data science and machine learning capability that is current. Strong Python and SQL, and the ability to interrogate large behavioural or transactional datasets yourself and defend your method under challenge.

  • A track record of taking an ambiguous question to a delivered dataset, model or capability, including deciding what was good enough.

  • Experience with a modern data stack comparable to ours: a cloud data lake, Spark or Databricks, and AWS.

  • Clear communication with technical and non technical stakeholders, and the ability to cascade direction to a team so that each person knows why their work matters.

  • Based in Washington, D.C. or willing to relocate there.

  • US citizenship

 

Bonus Points for:

  • Work on agentic systems, LLM agents or autonomous transaction flows, whether in compliance, payments, fraud or infrastructure.

  • Experience building a large dataset or collection from nothing, including the unglamorous parts: schema decisions, quality checks, and maintenance.

  • Blockchain or on chain data experience: clustering, attribution, heuristics, anomaly detection, mempool analysis, or research into privacy preserving systems.

  • Experience in payments, fraud or risk data science, where the cost of a false negative is commercial rather than academic.

  • Having grown a team from a few people to a full department, and being able to describe what broke on the way.

  • A PhD or equivalent research training, or a record of published applied research.

  • Experience in a regulated environment or with model risk management frameworks, whether in financial services, or as a vendor to it, or in another domain with equivalent assurance requirements.

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. 

At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.  

Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect.

IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group.

As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout.

The role

The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process.

You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy.

What you'll bring to the role

We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include:

  • Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles
  • PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing
  • Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps
  • Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role
  • ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols
  • Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles

Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital.

You should be confident working within an Agile framework, with an understanding of secure development practices and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and access management. An international mindset, sensitivity to local business priorities, and a collaborative approach are essential.

What’s in it for you? 
At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing.

When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation 
Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond 
Ongoing learning and development supported by tailored programmes and resources 
A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement 
Flexible working with a remote first working policy

Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you 
Discounted staff pet care  
Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers

At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. title: Neuroscientist
description:
Type: Full-time
Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site

The Role

Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models.

We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next.

Responsibilities

In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording

  • Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models

  • Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team

  • Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on

Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design

  • Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets

  • Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians

  • Iterate on experimental design based on data quality and downstream modelling needs

Data Analysis & Computational Modelling

  • Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets

  • Build and apply computational models to characterise neural and behavioural dynamics

  • Validate findings and communicate results clearly to the broader research team

Neuroscience → AI Translation

  • Partner with the ML team to translate biological findings into model design choices

  • Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture

  • Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience.

  • Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments

  • Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language

  • Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality

  • Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams

Valued (or willing to learn)

  • Experience with large-scale or multi-modal neurobehavioural datasets

  • Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals or foundation model training

  • Experience with computational modelling of neural or behavioural data

  • Prior work bridging neuroscience and AI/robotics research

title: AI Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence.

Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses.

Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore.


How we work

We build AI for our customers, not for its own sake. Every project starts from a clear benefit to the people using Gain, and ideas without one don't get built, however interesting the technology. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well. Model choices follow the evals. We don't commit to one LLM provider; we measure, and use whichever model gives our customers the best results.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • Build and improve agents that find company data points on the web using search, page navigation and structured extraction tools, and that weigh conflicting sources before committing to an answer.

  • Develop, improve and retrain the models that predict company financials such as revenue and EBITDA, and the likelihood and timing of buy and sell events.

  • Design and maintain evaluation suites, both offline against reference sets and live in production, so we can measure quality and switch between LLM providers to balance output quality and cost.

  • Ship your work into our production services, trace where pipelines fail, and fix the weakest links first.

  • Design with resources in mind. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, but you choose solutions with their compute, memory, bandwidth and model costs in view.

By month six you'll know each of our agent pipelines end to end, how to evaluate them and where they most need improving. You'll also know our custom ML models well enough to improve them or retrain them on new data.

Who are you?

  • At least 3 years of building both custom ML models and LLM-based pipelines or agents, with work that ran in production rather than only in demos.

  • Solid modelling fundamentals: feature engineering, validation that holds up on new data, and knowing when a model needs retraining.

  • A habit of measuring before claiming. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one.

  • Strong Python, including async code.

Nice to have: experience with noisy or conflicting data sources and financial or private-company data. 

The stack

  • Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI

  • LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents. We add new models when they prove themselves on our evals.

  • Web data: agents that gather data points through web search, page navigation and structured extraction tools

  • Database: PostgreSQL with pgvector

  • Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire

  • Cloud and tooling: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions

What do we offer?

  • Competitive base salary and annual bonus linked to your performance / OKRs

  • Attractive benefits including health & wellbeing allowance, work-from-home budget, learning & coaching benefits, etc. 

  • Flexible hybrid working model with 3 days per week in our Amsterdam office 

  • Healthy work-life balance allowing for planability and personal commitments 

  • Chance to grow with the company gaining increasing responsibilities, supported by lots of coaching and a feedback-driven approach 

  • Tremendous learning and career progression opportunities 

  • International environment with hubs in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore

  • Culture of trust, ownership and standard of excellence and a fun working atmosphere with regular outings and events 

  • Post product-market fit and aspiring unicorn status - this is an excellent time to join & grow with us!

Does this sound like a perfect match?

We are proud of our wonderful product and believe it has lots of potential. We are growing fast and having fun while building our platform and company. Bij BAS World bouwen we digitale producten waarmee klanten over de hele wereld trucks, machines en onderdelen kunnen kopen en verkopen. Ons platform ondersteunt een groot deel van onze internationale handelsprocessen en wordt dagelijks gebruikt door klanten en collega’s over de hele wereld.

Als Lead Software Engineer werk je niet alleen aan schaalbare software, maar geef je richting aan de manier waarop meerdere teams onze platformen ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Je bent een inhoudelijke kartrekker zonder formeel people manager te zijn. Je creëert alignment tussen teams, stimuleert engineering excellence en helpt Engineers om zelfstandig betere beslissingen te nemen. Daarbij blijf je zelf dicht bij de techniek: je denkt mee over architectuur, complexe technische vraagstukken en de verdere ontwikkeling van standaarden en werkwijzen.

Je impact zit niet alleen in wat je zelf bouwt, maar vooral in wat je binnen en buiten je team mogelijk maakt.

Onze IT-afdeling is opgedeeld in zogenoemde pijlers. We hebben vijf productpijlers: Operations, Parts & Tyres, Buyer, Seller, en Platform Engineering. Jij werkt samen met innovatieve productteams binnen een van deze pijlers. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één applicatie of één team. Samen met Engineers, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, Architecten en collega’s vanuit de business vertaal je productambities naar toekomstbestendige technische keuzes. Je brengt afhankelijkheden, risico’s en kansen vroeg in beeld en helpt teams om keuzes te maken die zowel vandaag als op de langere termijn waarde opleveren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je helpt de technische richting binnen jouw productdomein bepalen en uitdragen.

  • Je vertaalt productambities, architectuurkeuzes, technische risico’s en afhankelijkheden naar concrete technische prioriteiten voor de roadmap.

  • Je zorgt voor alignment tussen teams en voorkomt dat oplossingen los van elkaar worden ontworpen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met Engineers, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, architecten en collega’s vanuit de business.

  • Je maakt technische keuzes begrijpelijk en verbindt deze aan klantwaarde, risico’s en impact op de organisatie.

  • Je coacht Engineers bij complexe technische vraagstukken en helpt hen groeien in eigenaarschap en besluitvorming.

  • Je neemt het voortouw bij complexe incidenten en zorgt ervoor dat structurele verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

  • Je draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en het verbeteren van onze developer experience.

  • Je initieert verbeteringen in onze manier van werken - waaronder onze beweging richting Spec Driven Development en outcome-gerichte oplevering - en stimuleert teams om te experimenteren met AI, nieuwe technologieën en moderne engineeringtools.

Wij bieden jou

Bij BAS krijg je de ruimte om technische richting te bepalen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop wij software ontwikkelen.

  • Een rol met impact binnen meerdere teams en een volledig productdomein;

  • Veel autonomie en ruimte om technische keuzes te initiëren en uit te dragen;

  • Directe samenwerking met product, business en andere technische leiders;

  • Ruimte om te experimenteren met AI, cloud-native technologie en moderne engineeringpraktijken;

  • Interne en externe opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • Een internationale en dynamische werkomgeving;

  • De mogelijkheid om zelf je device te kiezen: een MacBook of Windows-laptop;

  • 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;

  • Een passend salaris en een goede pensioenregeling.


Jouw specificaties

Wanneer is deze functie iets voor jou?

Deze functie past bij jou wanneer je sterke technische kennis combineert met het vermogen om richting te geven en mensen mee te nemen.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring als Senior, Staff of Lead Software Engineer.

  • Je hebt aantoonbaar impact gemaakt buiten je eigen werkzaamheden, applicatie of team.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het maken, onderbouwen en uitdragen van architectuurkeuzes binnen complexe softwareomgevingen.

  • Je denkt in schaalbare en onderhoudbare oplossingen, maar voorkomt onnodige technische complexiteit.

  • Je kunt technische vraagstukken vertalen naar duidelijke keuzes voor technische en niet-technische stakeholders.

  • Je durft bestaande keuzes ter discussie te stellen en komt met concrete en onderbouwde alternatieven.

  • Je bent een coach en sparringpartner voor Engineers en helpt anderen om zelfstandig betere beslissingen te nemen.

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor resultaten, ook wanneer meerdere teams, systemen of stakeholders betrokken zijn.

  • Je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week op ons kantoor in Veghel, omdat we geloven in hechte samenwerking en snel schakelen.

Daarnaast heb je ervaring met een groot deel van de volgende onderwerpen:

  • Cloud-native softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur binnen AWS;

  • API’s en gedistribueerde systemen;

  • CI/CD en geautomatiseerd testen;

  • Relationele en niet-relationele databases;

  • Moderne frontend- en backendtechnologieën (PHP, Laravel);

  • Softwarearchitectuur, observability, security en schaalbaarheid.

Wij zijn BAS!

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Al onze kennis en ervaring hebben we verwerkt in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. BAS World legt de lat hoog: ons doel is om de toonaangevende wereldwijde marktplaats te worden voor de aan- en verkoop van gebruikte trucks, machines, trailers en bestelwagens. Deze ambitieuze visie wordt vormgegeven door ons internationale team van Product- en Tech-professionals. Zij staan aan het roer van een divers productportfolio, ontwikkeld voor kopers, verkopers, partners en medewerkers.

Passend bij onze hoge ambitie werken we als een productgedreven organisatie. Met agile principes genereren, valideren, testen en ontwikkelen we snel nieuwe ideeën. Onze focus ligt op het zo snel mogelijk creëren van waarde voor onze gebruikers, het verleggen van grenzen en het voortdurend doorontwikkelen in de dynamische wereldwijde markt.

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Een familiebedrijf met passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap is waar wij voor staan.

description:

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

voize is more than a scribe and far more than another documentation tool! We're defining & setting the benchmark what AI in healthcare actually looks like. As Product Manager - ML, you’ll sit at the core of our product, you’ll translate customer, Sales, and Customer Success signal into the ML product roadmap across our markets - defining what “better” means for our models, aligning stakeholders on priorities, and driving a shipping cadence that turns ML capability into measurable user value.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Own the ML product roadmap for core speech and NLP across our markets, turning field signal into clear priorities

  • Partner closely with Speech & NLP Leads as your roadmap counterparts to ship improvements to production

  • Improve the product analytics and ML data integration: close the gaps between what we want to achieve, what we can measure in production, and what we train our models on.

  • Own ML product KPIs (e.g., no-edit rate, documentation rate, edit rate per slot, transcription accuracy) and drive measurable improvements.

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • Extensive Experience in Product Management, background in speech recognition, NLP, or LLM-based product is a plus.

  • Strong technical fluency in ML: evaluation, training data, latency/quality trade-offs, and release mechanics (you don’t need to train models, but you do need to deeply understand them)

  • Track record of shipping ML-powered products to production with measurable user impact

  • Hands-on experience designing and operationalizing ML model evaluation frameworks

  • Excellent communication in English; German is required to lead customer and end-user conversations (roughly B2)

  • We are open to relocators, but this role is ideally based in Berlin and you’ll work in a hybrid set-up.

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • Become a co-creator of our success with a competitive s stock option program

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up, plus dedicated remote working days within the EU.

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

This regional recruitment campaign is designed to build engineering capability closer to the customers and communities we support.   • Manage a portfolio of advances to a defined arrears and collections policy.

  • Liaise effectively with applicants (or their brokers) and valuers in requests for additional relevant information to support the credit decisioning process.

  • Deliver an excellent service is given to customers, their brokers and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards.

  • Ensure compliance with all mandatory policies and adherence to credit procedures to maintain internal credit controls.

  • Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s.

  • Help develop appropriate MI and KPI indicators and reporting, maintaining suitable MI to enable a detailed understanding of Mortgage processing pipeline

  • Actively search for areas of improvement for the Bank and your team and take ownership for delivery of these, setting a good example by displaying appropriate values and behaviour

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Exposure/knowledge of underwriting, with experience in the SME sector, with an understanding of the competitor landscape and the dynamics and trends of the SME market.

  • Excellent credit/financial analysis skills including the analysis of financial accounts, budgets and cashflow forecasting, Understanding of the loan underwriting process and the risks involved and be able to assess applications within a personal discretion and make recommendations and take commercial decisions.

  • Experience of escalating and presenting at Credit Committee level and Arrears Management.

  • Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to build strong and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders such as the distribution team, operations team and senior management, plus 3rd party suppliers such as Intermediaries, Valuers and Solicitors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it.

  • The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Triage: Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself.

  • Cost per deal: There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them.

  • Automation: You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached.

  • Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it.

  • The ops team: You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them.

  • You build, not buy: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. Buying a tool or setting up workflows in Sheets doesn't count. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar.

  • Founder or product DNA: You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start.

  • Systems thinker: You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it.
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

How we work

  1. Reason from the ground up
    Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed
    We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership
    Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty

  5. Truly excellent customer service
    Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

title: Security Automation Engineer
description:
Northwave is a leading European cybersecurity specialist, protecting organisations against increasingly complex digital threats. With deep expertise in offensive and defensive security, behaviour, and monitoring, we support our customers through managed security services and high-impact consultancy. Our Security Operations Center plays a central role in this mission, operating as a high-trust, high-precision environment where technology and expertise come together.

To further strengthen this foundation, we are expanding our engineering capability within the SOC platform.

The role

As a Automation Engineer, you are responsible for designing, building, and evolving the technical stack that powers our Security Operations Center. You work at the intersection of engineering, automation, and security operations, ensuring that our monitoring platform scales reliably and remains operationally sharp.

You design deployment pipelines that enable seamless onboarding of new customers and use cases. You develop intelligent correlation and deduplication mechanisms so analysts and clients only see alerts and vulnerabilities that truly matter. You also create and maintain a centralized view of customer implementations, giving the SOC immediate insight into active configurations, use cases, and points of contact.

Your work directly impacts how efficiently our SOC operates and how effectively we protect critical infrastructure across Europe.

Technology & environment

You will work in an environment where engineering quality and operational reliability are essential:

  • Python for automation, orchestration, and building smart internal tooling

  • APIs for integrating and connecting security and monitoring systems

  • GNU/Linux environments with strong command-line usage

  • Networking fundamentals for designing, operating, and troubleshooting monitoring setups

  • Security-by-design as a default, not an afterthought


Who you are

  • You are an engineer who prefers systems over slogans. You like understanding how things actually work in production and improving them where they break, slow down, or create noise.

  • You have a done a similar job for at least 2 years.

  • You are comfortable working close to operations. You do not need everything fully specified upfront, and you are able to translate practical SOC needs into technical solutions that hold up under pressure.

  • You take ownership of what you build and feel responsible for keeping it understandable, maintainable, and secure.

  • You communicate clearly with analysts and engineers, make pragmatic choices, and focus on outcomes rather than theoretical perfection.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary, paid on the 25th, with annual review and 8% holiday allowance

  • Pension through Nationale Nederlanden, Northwave contributes 50%, including partner pension

  • 25 vacation days plus all Dutch national holidays

  • Generous special leave for marriage, birth, bereavement, care and parental leave

  • Lease car based on salary scale (electric welcome), or choose €0.25/km plus 50% of the lease budget as mobility allowance

  • MacBook, phone and accessories fully provided

  • €200 net annual allowance for flexible and remote working

  • Alleo budget for sports, wellness and leisure of your choice

  • Learning budget from €700 to €1,200 per year, up to €4,500 for longer programmes

  • Referral bonus when you bring in a great new colleague

  • Hybrid working from a modern office in Utrecht

  • Personal growth through the Role Model and FeedForward cycle, your ambitions and development front and centre


Why Northwave

At Northwave, this role sits close to real security operations. The systems you build are used daily by SOC analysts and directly affect how incidents are detected, escalated, and resolved.

You are not building demos or side projects. You are improving a production SOC stack that protects real organizations. Decisions are made quickly, technical input is taken seriously, and improvements are implemented rather than parked on a roadmap.

You work with experienced professionals in an environment that values competence, responsibility, and getting things right.

We are a leading global software provider of fast, affordable, and secure PDF solutions that are used by millions of people worldwide. Winner of numerous awards, Foxit has customers in more than 200 countries and global operations. We have a complete product line and an exciting and aggressive development schedule. Our proven PDF technology is disrupting the status quo establishment and has accelerated our company growth. We are proud to list as customers Google, Amazon, and NASDAQ, and with your skills and help, we plan to add many more. Foxit has offices all over the world, including locations in the US, Asia, Europe, and Australia. For more information, please visit https://www.foxit.com.

Why Foxit
 
Foxit is a fast-growing enterprise software company challenging the status quo in digital documents. Our mission is to become the #1 PDF solution by building innovative, market-leading products that help knowledge workers move faster, stay compliant, and get more done.
 
With hundreds of millions of users globally, Foxit gives ambitious Account Executives the opportunity to own a meaningful territory, sell proven enterprise solutions, and win new business in competitive markets — backed by a strong internal team and a well-established channel partner ecosystem.
 
About the Role
 
As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will own and grow a defined territory across Benelux and France. You will be responsible for driving net-new enterprise revenue, expanding strategic accounts, and managing complex SaaS sales cycles across Foxit’s solutions portfolio.
 
This role is ideal for a true hunter — someone who can build pipeline, develop executive relationships, and consistently close enterprise business in competitive environments. You should be comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder buying groups, running a disciplined sales process, and managing opportunities from prospecting through close.
 
What You’ll Do
 
New Business & Revenue Growth
  • Drive and close net-new enterprise opportunities across Benelux and France Expand existing enterprise accounts by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Foxit’s broader solutions portfolio
  • Own revenue growth across your territory by advancing and closing high-value opportunities
 
Territory Strategy & Pipeline Management
  • Build and execute a strategic territory plan, including target accounts, partner engagement, and pipeline coverage
  • Generate and maintain healthy pipeline through outbound activity, account prioritization, and partner collaboration
  • Maintain strong pipeline discipline through accurate forecasting, CRM hygiene, and consistent deal progression
 
Enterprise Sales Execution
  • Manage the full sales cycle end-to-end, from prospecting and discovery through solution alignment, negotiation, and close Lead complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, decision-makers, and buying committees
  • Navigate competitive sales situations and lead opportunities where Foxit can displace incumbent solutions
 
Executive Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Present Foxit’s value proposition clearly and credibly to senior stakeholders and cross-functional buying groups
  • Build strong relationships across customer organizations, from key users to executive decision-makers Partner closely with BDRs, Channel Managers, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Support, and Marketing to move opportunities forward
  • Collaborate on territory-based campaigns, partner activity, and broader go-to-market initiatives across the region
 
Market Presence
  • Travel as needed for customer meetings, partner engagements, and industry events
 
What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of SaaS sales or enterprise software sales experience
  • Fluency in either Dutch or French; both is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success managing enterprise sales cycles from lead to close
  • Clear track record of pipeline generation, net-new business development, and quota achievement
  • Experience with consultative, solution-based, and value-driven selling
  • Strong executive presence with excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Strong territory management, prioritization, and forecasting discipline
  • Ability to build credibility internally and externally and align stakeholders throughout the sales process
  • Customer-first mindset with strong commercial judgment and account ownership
  • Collaborative, high-performance approach in a fast-paced environment
 
Nice to Have
  • Experience selling into Benelux and France, directly and/or through partners
  • Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes and complex buying committees
  • Experience operating in a partner-influenced or channel-supported sales environment

title: Principal Product Security Engineer
description:
Make Your Mark as an Principal Product Security Engineer at Storio group

About the role.

You will be based in our Amsterdam office, where you will help shape how security is built into our ecommerce platform and engineering organisation. This is a senior individual contributor role operating at the intersection of Product Security and Application Security. You will work directly with engineers, architects, and product teams to solve complex security problems, influence technical decisions, and make secure-by-design engineering the standardnorm. You will have significant autonomy and influence to establish practical security standards, raise security capability across teams, and guide the secure adoption of AI across our engineering ecosystem.



How you embrace curiosity daily.

  • You collaborate closely with engineers, architects, and product teams to find  turn security challenges into pragmatic solutions for security challenges.
  • You mentor engineers and Security Champions to make security increasingly embedded within engineering culture.

  • You build and enable security automation that improves security outcomes while reducing friction for engineering teams.

  • You lead threat modelling and security architecture reviews for key products and technology initiatives to identify problems early.

  • You experiment with and adopt AI tools creatively to automate security engineering workflows and boost productivity.



    • How you make your mark.

  • You define security principles, standards, patterns, and guardrails that enable engineers to build securely at pace.

  • You shape the strategic technical direction of Product Security across our entire platform and engineering organisation.

  • You protect our platform by providing hands-on expertise across APIs, microservices, cloud infrastructure (AWS), authentication, authorisation, and software supply chain security.

  • You identify and mitigate emerging security risks,including those introduced by AI, and communicate potential impact clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • You measure what matters by developing meaningful Product Security metrics to continuously drive security posture improvements.



    • What you bring to the team.

  • You bring significant (5+ years) experience in Product Security, Application Security, or Security Engineering within a modern software environment.

  • You have strong experience in security architecture and threat modelling, with a proven ability to turn risk into practical engineering solutions.

  • You possess deep technical knowledge of application and API security, secure development practices, modern software architectures, and cloud-native systems.

  • You bring experience embedding security controls into engineering workflows, software supply chains (SBOMs), and the broader software development lifecycle.

  • You are an excellent communicator who builds trust and influences engineers, architects, and senior technical leaders without relying on direct authority.

  • You have experience with, or a strong interest in, AI security and leveraging AI tools to advance security engineering.



    • What sets you apart.

  • You have hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security, scaling Security Champions programs, or managing Bug Bounty programs.

  • You hold relevant industry or cloud security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CSSLP, AWS Security Specialty), though we care far more about your practical impact than the certificates you hold.

title: Principal iOS Engineer
description:
Make Your Mark as an Principal iOS Engineer at Storio group

About the role

You will join our Amsterdam based Browse and Manage App team. This team builds the storefront, product discovery, and account management experiences for our native mobile applications across all Storio Group brands. Your technical leadership will directly help customers find the best products for their special moments through high quality iOS features.

As our iOS Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for the iOS platform within the team. You will champion technical quality, own the iOS architecture roadmap, and ensure the long term health of our codebase. You will collaborate closely with product and engineering teams in Amsterdam and London to make our native app experience best in class.


How you embrace curiosity daily

  • Define and own the iOS target architecture and technical roadmap

  • Lead the design of scalable, performant, and maintainable iOS features

  • Guide critical architectural decisions and help shape implementation choices

  • Support the team in using AI assisted engineering tools safely and productively

  • Collaborate with other principal engineers on shared solutions and platform strategies

  • Mentor iOS engineers to support their technical growth and foster a culture of learning


    • How you make your mark

  • Raise engineering quality standards by improving testing, CI CD, and codebase health

  • Deliver a seamless storefront and discovery experience across all Storio Group brands

  • Ensure the long term health and scalability of our mobile codebase

  • Shape development processes and tooling to improve team quality and flow

  • Align with product and engineering managers on the feasibility and success of roadmap items

  • Help the team evaluate and adopt modern engineering workflows effectively


    • What you bring to the team

  • Deep expertise in building and scaling native iOS apps using Swift

  • Strong skills in mobile architecture, system design, and technical decision making

  • Proven experience leading complex technical initiatives and mentoring engineers

  • Experience evolving and maintaining long lived, scalable codebases

  • Comfort working with tech stacks like UIKit, SwiftUI, SPM, and GraphQL

  • Familiarity with modern AI assisted coding tools and their practical limits


    • What sets you apart

  • Understanding of Android architecture and constraints in shared mobile contexts

  • Prior knowledge or experience in the ecommerce domain

  • Experience improving developer productivity through automation, CI CD, or scripting

    • About us
    At Storio Group, we help people hold onto life's moments. We make personalised photo products that turn fleeting memories into things you can keep, share, and re-live.

    Every person at Storio Group helps create our products and shape our company. You will see the impact of your work daily. We invite you to make your mark on our business, products, and customers' lives.

    We act with heart by putting people first and valuing diverse perspectives. We give our best and aim for high standards in all we do. We own our work, taking initiative to find solutions. We embrace curiosity, always learning and trying new things. We find the joy in our work and create a positive environment.

    Equal Opportunities & Right to Work
    Storio Group is an equal opportunity employer, celebrating diversity and fostering an inclusive environment. If you require reasonable adjustments during interviews please contact our HR team.

    Applicants must also have the legal right to work in the position's country without requiring sponsorship.
